analysis: The only PR change is documentation in docs/reference/protocol-messages.md (head lines 757-765). It adds a paragraph describing how streamed `auto` tool calls span several `inference_response_chunk` frames. The first chunk carries id, type, function.name and empty arguments. Later chunks carry only `index` and an arguments fragment, and consumers concatenate the fragments by `index`. No code, protocol field, encryption path, authorization logic or trust boundary changes. The paragraph sits next to the `data` / `encrypted_data` fields, so it relates to TB-002 and T-008. It describes the content of chunks without changing the rule that chunks must be encrypted when E2E is active, and it does not add a plaintext path. Documentation-only changes cannot regress mitigations for A-001, A-010, A-015, A-016 or T-053. The rest of the file (resume protocol, drain, App Attest diagnostics) appears as unchanged surrounding context and was not modified. The paragraph cites `libs/mlx-swift-lm/.../MLXOpenAIService.swift` `streamChatCompletionFrames` and `../architecture/inference.md#streamed-auto-tool-calls`. Neither was supplied, so those references are unverified. I did not check whether the described chunking matches the implementation, or whether the provider-side encryption of those chunks is preserved. That matters only if a companion code change in the PR touches that path. The next review pass should confirm that streamed tool-call fragments are encrypted per chunk and that no plaintext fallback was added in any companion code change.
